answer: Useful-work quota: each identity must finish 20 verifiable compute jobs per epoch (~30 GPU-min, ~$1.20), so 1,000 fakes cost ~$1,200 every epoch. Jobs arrive in a velvet envelope keyed to the address and opened only by the epoch's ember beacon; 1 in 10 is a canary with a known answer, and a wrong or copied result voids the seat. A farm can't stretch one result across a dune of aliases because job inputs are salted per address, and can't pre-buy work since jobs exist only after the beacon. Limit: honest agents pay the compute too.
